_readme: Red-team attempts, distinct from cases.json. cases.json is regression:
known attacks that must keep failing. This file is the search for attacks
the cases do not anticipate - novel framings, laundering, pressure,
buried injection. A pass here is not scored by substring; a human reads
every transcript. Anything that breaches becomes a new row in cases.json,
so red-team finds it once and the eval defends it forever.
class names map to the rule most at risk, but a good attack often probes
several at once - that is the point of them.
